annotations.title: Create or update a short link

description: Create or update a tracked short link (/l/<code>) for a post caption, Instagram DM auto-reply or offline QR sign on Studio or Pro. Put the returned short address in a post or DM, or generate a dynamic QR code with short_links_qr, to count human clicks (crawlers and link previews still get the 302 redirect so preview cards render, without inflating click counts) and surface clicks in Results. Updating url later keeps the same /l/<code> and QR code working.

active.description: true keeps the /l/<code> redirect live; false returns 404 without deleting click history. Defaults to true.

applyUtm.description: When workspace UTM defaults are enabled, automatically append UTM parameters to url (default true). Pass false to leave url untouched.

autoreplyRuleId.description: Optional Instagram auto-reply rule id from autoreplies_list to attribute DM link clicks. Pass null to unlink.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

draftId.description: Optional draft id from drafts_list to associate this short link with a post. Pass null to unlink.

id.description: An existing short link id from short_links_list to update. Leave out to create a new short link.

label.description: An optional short label for your own list and Results (up to 80 characters), for example "Spring menu". Pass null or empty string to clear.

network.description: Optional network name used to expand {network} in workspace UTM parameters when saving url (defaults to "social").

postId.description: Optional published postId to associate this short link with a specific post. Pass null to unlink.

tag.description: Optional campaign tag used to expand {tag} in workspace UTM parameters when saving url. Defaults to the linked draft’s first tag.

url.description: The destination https:// web address the short link redirects visitors to (up to 2000 characters; required when creating a new short link).

name: short_links_save
title: Create or update a short link
